name: Anti-Recidivism Coalition (ARC)
description: Comprehensive reentry support including housing, employment, and education assistance
fullDescription: The Anti-Recidivism Coalition provides reentry support, advocacy, and community for people coming home from incarceration in California, with member offices in Los Angeles and Sacramento.
whatTheyOffer:
- Case management, trauma-informed counseling, and mentorship
- Housing assistance
- Workforce, career readiness, and credential programs
- Education support
- Felony expungement help
- Programs inside prisons and detention facilities
- Policy advocacy
howToGetIt:
1. Fill out the ARC member application online
2. Attend an in-person orientation (Mon-Fri, 11 AM-12 PM; arrive 15 minutes early)
3. Orientations are held at ARC's Los Angeles office (601 N. Alvarado St) or Sacramento office (2830 G St, Suite 210)
4. Meet with staff to access services and join the member community
5. Call 213-955-5885 (Los Angeles) or 916-850-3158 (Sacramento) with questions
keywords: Anti-Recidivism Coalition, ARC, reentry, formerly incarcerated, housing assistance, employment support, education, expungement, policy advocacy, peer support, case management
